sentences.text:
Padmanav Swain And Another vs The State Of Orissa And
Others .... ... on 8 August, 2025

Bench: K.R. Mohapatra, Savitri Ratho
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 W.P.(C). No. 21659 Of 2025
 Padmanav Swain and Another ....

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. Srinibash Satapathy, Advocate
 -versus-
 The State of Orissa and Others .... Opposite Partie
 Mr. Swayambhu Mishra, As
 Coram:
 Justice K.R. Mohapatra
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
 Order No. 08.08.2025
 01.
1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. It is submitted by Mr. Srinibash Satapathy, learned counsel for the Petitioners that being not satisfied with the award passed under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the Petitioners have made application under Section 64 of the Act to the Land Acquisition Officer, Salapada, Keonjhar.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: But no action has yet been taken on the same.

3. Hence, Mr. Swayambhu Mishra, learned Additional Standing Counsel shall take instruction with regard to status of the application filed by the Petitioners on 11th April, 2025 under Section 64 of the Act.

4. Put up on 1st September, 2025.
5. Instructions, if any, shall be obtained in the meantime.
(K.R. Mohapatra) Judge by: PUSPANJALI MOHAPATRA (Savitri Ratho) Designation: Personal Assistant Reason: Authentication Location: Orissa High Court Judge Date: 08-Aug-2025 17:39:33
